summary: Resume-state detection checks only part of the versioned artifact family.
root_cause: The resume detector only checks for the existence of a 'comments_v' file and does not independently discover or validate the latest version of the 'script' artifact family. Consequently, a partially persisted state (comments present, script absent) is treated as a complete resume point.
suggested_fix: Extend the state discovery logic to scan for both artifact families independently. Retrieve the latest version of each family (e.g., comments_<version>.md and script_<version>.py). If any required artifact family is missing, either refuse to resume and report an incomplete state or trigger explicit re-generation. After discovery, update the version pointer and state metadata for all families before proceeding.

deterministic_confirmation.reason: deterministic oracle failure with sufficient code/trace evidence

not_model_fault_because: The defect is present in deterministic code, documentation, or framework configuration and can be mitigated without changing model parameters.

evidence.description: Documentation mentions only 'comments_v' file for state detection.
Metadata recovery initializes `last_comment_file` with 'comments_v.md' but does not attempt to detect 'script_v' independently.
Resume flow activates solely on the presence of an existing 'comments_v' file; the script artifact family is never probed.
Workflow fails to validate completeness across both artifact families before passing state to downstream components.
